sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Courses"."author_id" AS e, "Course_Authors_and_Tutors"."gender_mf" AS g, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "Courses" JOIN "Course_Authors_and_Tutors" ON "Course_Authors_and_Tutors"."author_id" = "Courses"."author_id"  GROUP BY "Courses"."author_id", "Course_Authors_and_Tutors"."gender_mf"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m2" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: share of the all total of number of Courses records (all level)
rank within the group by number of Courses records: share of the all total, keep the top 3
